text: I am updating the Marrow Fieldworks file. What do we have on the driver SMS prompt glitch on overflow lots, and on the West yard Door 2 double-booking?
reply_text:
I sent Pree my findings in our DM. Both issues have ticket numbers, but neither has a status update after the dates below.

- **Driver SMS prompt glitch on overflow lots:** this is ticket #4412. Hollis flagged it as open in the Central handoff note dated 2 Jan 2026, written before Marrow Fieldworks changed hands on 5 Jan. The note calls it a minor glitch that happens when combine trailers are staged on unpaved overflow lots. The same note lists a second open ticket, #4409: a recurring timeout on the Gatehouse Check-In report at the Salina North yard. I found nothing about #4412 after January, so I can't say whether it's been fixed.
- **West yard Door 2 double-booking:** on 13 Oct in #central-random, Tobias said the Door 2 double-booking still happens when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk. He said he'd flagged it to support on ticket #8841. That message refers to "Tobias's dealer account" and doesn't name Marrow Fieldworks. I said I was assuming it's the same account and told Pree to confirm with Tobias. I found no follow-up on #8841.

I couldn't open any Marrow Fieldworks ticket or CRM files in the share, so I suggested she ask Tobias or Hollis for the current status of both tickets. I only used sources she can see herself: #central-team, #central-random and the public notes and digests.
